dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: I behold the magnificent vistas of three thousand worlds and am intimately acquainted with the threads of past and future.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Feebly does the expanse that appears before me endeavor to capture my attention.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Hmph. No mortal lifetime bears the imagination required to fathom the collective phenomena experienced by the Prinzessin.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: This place is but a grain of sand in the shadow of my Immernachtreich.

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: But mein Fräulein, you previously said that you wished to stay here for a while.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: #That... that was but to demonstrate solidarity for {F#her}{M#him} as a kindred soul of the outrealm!

choices.text: As long as you like it.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: For a mortal domicile, it offers a modicum of respite.
